name: w3_staircase_plus_minus_40_pattern
description: Matrix 3 (M3) Reference Clock and Bias Staircase Pattern evenly distributed between -40 and +40 LSB across 6 columns

matrix_3_rows_description.rows_0_to_5: Data rows (Inputs X0..X5) - Flat zero baseline [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
matrix_3_rows_description.row_6: Reference Clock Cell (ClkB1, 330k discharge resistor, fast dynamic ramp) - Ascending staircase [-40, -24, -8, 8, 24, 40]
matrix_3_rows_description.row_7: Bias / Reference DC Anchor Cell (ClkRef, slow retention) - Complementary staircase [+40, +24, +8, -8, -24, -40]

rationale: Complementary polarities (Row 6 + Row 7 = 0 at t=0) prevent ColTIA summing junction DC saturation while maximizing dynamic differential clock ramp across the Sigmoid 4 activation function across the 4.5 ms to 5.5 ms temporal window.
